formal_architecture_setting.note: This focused validation run compares shared-only CNN-BiLSTM, PhysInput-Lite, PhysInput-Adv3, PhysInput-Conv3, and PhysInput-All4 CNN-BiLSTM. All models use the same grid-level intensity-aware Huber loss, sample weights, learning rate, batch size, early stopping, and best-val-event checkpoint. PhysInput models use the same CNN-BiLSTM architecture with different physical diagnostic input-channel combinations, without gate, residual, SCA, hard max, candidate rainfall, Attention, or test-time post-processing.

lagged_rainfall_input.fair_input_rule: All formal models use ERA5 predictors and lagged observed rainfall.
